describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile walking on four legs. Its overall body, head, limbs, fur and tail are those of a brown bear with thick shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and underbelly, but its back is covered by a large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle exoskeleton and a single long curved beetle horn rises from the center of its forehead. The bear-like head has a long snout, black nose and brown eyes, the body is stocky with four sturdy clawed paws, a very short stubby tail at the rear, and the shiny domed shell sits fused to the dorsal side from the shoulders to the rump with a separate smaller plate over the shoulders and a row of small oval breathing holes visible along the lower edge where the shell meets the fur.
